data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6123 reported a prior year reserve release of USD 0.383 million for the 2015 underwriting year, derived from the gross claims development triangle. This represents a 15.09% reduction relative to the total opening gross claims outstanding. No specific cause was provided for this release, suggesting favorable claims development. The syndicate noted material exposure to Hurricanes Harvey and Irma in the 2016 and 2017 years of account, which contributed to an increased net loss ratio in 2017, but these events were not linked to the prior year development for older years. The syndicate's business is primarily reinsurance of property in the U.S.
raw_causal_phrases: The SPA has material exposure to the Hurricanes Harvey and Irma in the 2016 and 2017 year of account. This has caused the increase in net loss ratio during the 2017 calendar year.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development calculated from gross claims development triangle for UW year 2015. No specific cause for the 2015 release was identified in the report. Hurricanes Harvey and Irma were noted for 2016/2017 YOA, not for prior year development of older years.
